name: BFB Health Limited
summary: BFB Health Limited operates as an investment holding company, overseeing a diverse range of business activities. The firm offers advertising agency services to clients throughout both mainland China and Hong Kong. Its operations also encompass the distribution of books and magazines, along with providing comprehensive securities brokerage services, including trading, financing, underwriting, and placement. Furthermore, the company engages in money lending and manages various e-commerce platforms. BFB Health Limited is based in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
